mechanisms.behavior: The manual distinguishes six numbered trough positions and one jam opto, but supplies four balls. The Trough diagnostic fires the ejector and checks the sensor changes. Ball transfer timing, default occupied subset, opto active levels and jam recovery remain unverified.
mechanisms.label: Trough and serve

mechanisms.behavior: The manual lists the shooter-lane rollover, cabinet Launch button and Auto Plunger. Their timing and scoring behavior await an exact-ROM run; no manual-plunger geometry is inferred.
mechanisms.label: Shooter lane and automatic launcher

mechanisms.behavior: The manual distinguishes one POWER driver reference, a cabinet button leaf and fitted playfield EOS leaf. The public EOS is synthesized by PinMAME; no winding count, physical rest state, travel or tuning is asserted.
mechanisms.label: Lower left flipper

mechanisms.behavior: The manual distinguishes one POWER driver reference, a cabinet button leaf and fitted playfield EOS leaf. The public EOS is synthesized by PinMAME; no winding count, physical rest state, travel or tuning is asserted.
mechanisms.label: Lower right flipper

mechanisms.behavior: The printed driver and switch each have a combined left/right label. That is evidence of a shared controller identity, not proof of load quantity or electrical fan-out. Physical feedback and causality need a trace or schematic.
mechanisms.label: Combined sling driver

mechanisms.behavior: The manual prints this combined route at driver7, with driver6 genuinely blank. Do not shift the row to6 because of flattened text extraction. Fitted load quantity and shared wiring need further evidence.
mechanisms.label: Combined left/right pop driver

mechanisms.behavior: Own driver and switch tables identify the bottom-pop route; reset timing and reflex behavior await exact firmware evidence.
mechanisms.label: Bottom pop bumper

mechanisms.behavior: Manual page11 describes a three-bit target-bank diagnostic and Start-driven reset; pages13/17 identify the reset and left/center/right optos. Home/rest sensor levels, scoring sequence, timing and failure recovery remain unresolved.
mechanisms.label: Three-target drop bank

mechanisms.behavior: The driver table names Control Gates and page11 describes right-ramp lock testing. It does not settle the gate topology, number of controlled loads, normal position or whether the exit opto is direct feedback; no electrical relationship is invented.
mechanisms.label: Control gates and right-ramp ball lock
